city.description: Narrow the search by city (e.g. 'Dallas'). Optional.
city.title: City

email.description: Email address to reverse-lookup (e.g. 'jane@example.com'). Optional alternative to name search.
email.title: Email Address

fullName.description: The full name of the person to look up (e.g. 'John Smith'). Combine with city/state for best results.
fullName.title: Full Name

maxItems.description: Maximum number of matching people profiles to return. Defaults to 3.
maxItems.title: Max Items

phone.description: Phone number to reverse-lookup (e.g. '(214) 349-3972'). Optional alternative to name search.
phone.title: Phone Number

proxyConfiguration.description: radaris.com blocks datacenter IPs. RESIDENTIAL US proxy is hardcoded; do not disable.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

state.description: US state abbreviation to narrow the search (e.g. 'CA', 'TX', 'NY'). Optional.
state.title: State
